CustomField.description: Estimated exercise duration including working time and rest between sets.
CustomField.label: Estimated Duration (Minutes)
CustomField.formula: ROUND((BLANKVALUE(Target_Sets__c, 0) * IF(Is_Timed__c, BLANKVALUE(Target_Seconds__c, 0), BLANKVALUE(Enter_the_planned_number_of_sets_for_thi__c, 0) * IF(OR(ISBLANK(Sides_Per_Set__c), Sides_Per_Set__c = 0), 1, Sides_Per_Set__c) * 3) + MAX(0, BLANKVALUE(Target_Sets__c, 0) - 1) * BLANKVALUE(Rest_Seconds__c, 0)) / 60, 2)
